segments.name: Investment function
segments.description: Manages the investment portfolio of the insurance holding company and its insurance subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: At December 31, 2025, we had three segments: our investment function, our commercial lines of insurance and our personal lines of insurance.

segments.name: Commercial lines of insurance
segments.description: Provides commercial property and casualty insurance products to businesses in Mid-Atlantic, Midwestern, Southern and Southwestern states.
segments.evidence: The commercial lines products of our insurance subsidiaries consist primarily of commercial automobile, commercial multi-peril and workers' compensation policies.

segments.name: Personal lines of insurance
segments.description: Provides personal property and casualty insurance products to individual policyholders in smaller to mid-sized regional communities.
segments.evidence: The personal lines products of our insurance subsidiaries consist primarily of homeowners and private passenger automobile policies.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums for property and casualty insurance coverage, and the company also earns investment income on its portfolio.
revenueModel.evidence: Our insurance subsidiaries and Donegal Mutual provide their policyholders with a selection of insurance products and pursue profitability by adhering to a strict underwriting discipline.

changes.text: In 2025, Donegal Mutual and Southern entered into a renewal rights agreement to non-renew all farm policies beginning in the second quarter of 2026.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, Donegal Mutual and Southern entered into a renewal rights agreement with a farm-focused Pennsylvania-based mutual insurance company to provide a continuation option for our farm policyholders when they begin to non-renew all farm policies as they expire beginning in the second quarter of 2026.
